messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: [Service Status Announcement] Deployment issues 8-10-2015
parts:
Hi all,

We are experience technical issues because of an outage our service provider (AWS) is having with the Amazon S3 service.

Most currently deployed applications should be working normally, but application deployments and deletions may be failing. 

I will send an update when the issue is resolved.

We apologize for the inconvenience. Thanks for your understand, and thanks for using shinyapps.io!

-Andy

Hi all.

The issues with our service provider have been resolved, so applications should be deploying once again. Please reach out if you are still experiencing issues.
